notes: Safety and privacy: you can now block someone, and report a message — you choose whether to attach a readable copy, and a person reviews every report. Voice transcription, translation, link previews and GIF search now ask before they send anything off your device, with a switch for each in Settings. New in Settings: download all your data, delete your account for real, and the Terms, Privacy Policy and Accessibility Statement. Screen readers now name every button, announce new messages and reach every menu. And the app lock can no longer be skipped by opening a chat link directly.
